verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents operating the product through natural language in two ways. Its own chat lets users describe what they want and get an agent or automation built, and agents can be drafted and edited from plain-language prompts. Its built-in MCP server also lets AI assistants build flows, manage tables and test automations through natural language, and drive the whole platform. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably across the platform.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Describe what you want in chat, and Activepieces builds the agent or automation for you.
Activepieces includes a built-in MCP server that lets AI assistants build flows, manage tables, test automations, and more — all through natural language.
Connect Claude, Cursor, Codex or any MCP client and it drives the whole platform.
describe a change in the editor — "only reply to paying customers" — and the instructions and tools are rewritten for you
